question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means "A is the brother of B"

A - B means "A is the son of B"

A × B means "A is the wife of B"

A ÷ B means "A is the father of B"

Based on the above, how is Q related to S if "P - Q ÷ R × S + T
solution:

Statements given : P - Q ÷ R × S + T

P - Q means P is the son of Q

Q ÷ R means Q is the father of R

R × S means R is the wife of S

S + T means S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e247d63060d5b414509915b9e6e06419be0782ae17c9388a78e751945f5da76f.png] 

**So, Q is father of R who is wife of S.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
